Drought (one of): (1) >=50% probability of below-average rainfall from at least two seasonal rainfall forecasts; (2) drought named as a driver of the deterioration of the food security situation. triggers.indicator: RSMC Nadi (Fiji Meteorological Service) 120-hour TC track forecast: forecast category (Australian scale) and best-track position; the 72-120 h part is the unofficial, unpublished extension (p.6, p.23)
